desc:
🃏 Welcome to Steal an Anime Girl Card!

How to Play:
😈 Steal card packs right under the bosses' noses!
🥷 Steal packs from other players and protect your own!
🗺️ Race through anime worlds to the boss lairs
🏃 Train on treadmills to gain Speed
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmills to run even faster
📦 Open packs at your base to collect anime cards
💰 Earn money from your cards every second
🏆 Grade your cards from F to S at the Shrine of Rank
⭐ Show off your best card on your base pedestal

✨ Discover rarer cards: Epic, Legendary, Mythic, Secret, Eternal, Divine and OP!
🌈 Hunt for Foil, Holo, Shiny and Cosmic Holo variants!

🎁 Join our group for a FREE gift!
👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to get notified about new cards and updates!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet players
